title: Pines speculates the psionic programs use genetic lines, drug cocktails and youth training

tellings.quote: protocols. They realize that there's certain individuals that have an inherent predisposition for this. They maybe have figured out genetic, you know, lines that are just naturally disposed for this. They figure out maybe some cocktails of drugs to give to people in a training regimen when they're young and then they get them into these programs

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines guesses at how secret government programmes in psionics, meaning the use of the mind for things like telepathy, might find and train their people. He tells Michels, without naming a source, that such programmes may have learned that some people are born with a knack for it, may have traced "genetic lines" that carry it, and may give young recruits "cocktails of drugs" as part of a training regimen before bringing them in. He offers it as speculation about how a hidden psychic programme could be built.
